name: H2 EDU
summary: Unitree H2 EDU: the research/development edition of the H2 full-size humanoid — same 1.82 m, 70 kg, 31-joint body, 0.972 kWh battery (~3 h) and voice-interaction hardware as H2, plus a second computer ('PC2：Intel Core i7（Custom Development）'), secondary development support, optional dexterous hands ('Multiple Model Options') and an optional high-power computing module ('such as Thor'); 12-month warranty. Sold through Unitree sales ('Contact Sales'). Sources: unitree.com/H2 and reichelt.com, agent-retrieved 2026-09-11.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-09-11 by Claude Opus 5 (curl + WebFetch) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny for European Catalogue Gap Batch 01B, under research work order 'OWNER WORK ORDER — BATCH 01B COMMERCIAL RESEARCH' (2026-09-11; docs/26 §2.1). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. Values from Unitree's H2 parameter table (unitree.com/H2): height_cm 182.0 ('1820 x 456 x 218mm'), weight_kg 70.0 ('About 70kg'), degrees_of_freedom 31 (6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head), battery_wh 972.0 ('15Ah(0.972KWh)' — a unit conversion of the stated kWh, not a derivation), runtime_minutes 180 ('About 3h'). payload_kg 7.0 is the RATED per-arm payload: 'Arm Maximum Payload【1】 Peak: ~15 kg; Rated: ~7 kg' — the rated figure is recorded, the peak is preserved here. has_language_ui TRUE: 'Voice Interaction — Array Microphone and High-Power Speaker for Voice Interaction' is listed for both H2 and H2 EDU. VOICE ATTRIBUTION: Unitree attributes voice interaction (microphone array + speaker) to both editions but makes no large-language-model claim in the parameter table; the page's marketing line 'Powered by a 2070 TOPS chip, it supports diverse intelligent models' refers to the optional high-power computing module ('such as Thor'), listed for H2 EDU only — it is NOT recorded as base-H2 compute. Basic computing: 'PC1：Intel Core i5（Platform Capabilities）' (both); 'PC2：Intel Core i7（Custom Development）' (H2 EDU only). Distributor spec rows (reichelt, QUADRUPED.DE) agree on 31 DoF, 1820 mm, 70 kg, 0.972 kWh, ~3 h. walk_speed, autonomy, reach, arm span, ros_support and simulation_support are not stated and stay UNKNOWN. model_code stays NULL (reichelt part numbers 'H2-BASIC' / 'H2-EDU' are seller identifiers). has_sdk TRUE / developer_edition TRUE: 'Secondary Development [2] H2 EDU: YES'. Identity: this record is the base H2 EDU edition; reichelt's 'H2 EDU Standard' (no hands; PC1 i5 + PC2 i7) is mapped to it. QUADRUPED.DE additionally lists 'H2 EDU Smart A'–'M' hand/compute configurations; those are NOT mapped to this record. hand_type / hand_dof UNKNOWN: hands are optional ('Dexterous Hand (Multiple Model Options)') and the Standard edition ships without them.
